appliesToWhy: RESEARCH-ROUTES-1 part 2 (D-STOPLINE-CLAIM, #391 6681022221; ruled #400 6681126219): every library sheet with a stop-on-pain line ("Don't train through the pain", or a pain row whose fix is "Stop the set.") on main 5023f5c6 and on claude/lib-ship-w3b, w4, w5, w6 and w7 (git grep of tools/plates/library/howto, 2026-11-06). Each such row is a wrist, back, elbow, knee or shoulder row, which c1-c3 cover. box_jump ("Stop the set. Keep reps low with full rest.", tired legs) and hollow_body_hold ("Stop the set if it lifts", form) stop for other reasons and are left out.

line.text: Stop the set. Don't train through the pain.

claims.text: NHS self-care advice for wrist pain, back pain and tennis elbow is to stop or cut down activities that cause pain or make it worse (written for those conditions, applied here to training).

quotes.text: stop or cut down activities that are causing the pain
quotes.where: How you can ease wrist pain yourself: Do

quotes.text: But stop if your pain gets worse and see a GP for advice.
quotes.where: Exercises and stretches for back pain

quotes.text: avoid or reduce activities that make your symptoms worse
quotes.where: Things you can do to help ease tennis elbow: Do

claims.text: Healthline tells lifters to stop hamstring curls if they feel pain in the knees (written for hamstring curls, applied here to training).

quotes.text: Stop doing hamstring curls if you feel pain in your knees, hips, or back.

claims.text: Motra's exercise guides tell lifters to stop if shoulder pain occurs (written for the Smith machine shoulder press and the cable external rotation, applied here to training).

sources.title: 5 Types of Hamstring Curls for Stronger Thighs (Healthline)
Smith Machine Shoulder Press - Exercise Guide (Motra)
Cable External Shoulder Rotation: Exercise Guide (Motra, formerly Train Fitness)

gaps: No general (all-exercise) stop-on-pain source was found for the knee or the shoulder: the NHS knee-pain page has only "put as little weight as possible on your knee", and the NHS shoulder-pain page says "do not completely stop using your shoulder". c2 and c3 are exercise-specific lines applied to training.
Finucane 2020 (JOSPT, PMID 32438853), behind the app's pain_red_flags entry, is a red-flag framework for serious spinal pathology and does not address stopping a set, so it is not used.
notes: All six pages fetched by curl on 2026-11-06 (HTTP 200); each quote is a verbatim substring of the page text. nhs-wrist-pain keeps sources.json's URL (conditions/hand-pain/wrist-pain/), which redirects to symptoms/hand-pain/wrist-pain/ (the page read).
